lines.text: A popcorn pop, in slow motion.
lines.phonemes: ɐ pˈɑːpkɔːɹn pˈɑːp, ɪn slˈoʊ mˈoʊʃən.

lines.text: In the pan on the stove, a few kernels of popcorn sit still. Then one jumps. Its hard shell holds the steam in, until the pressure wins. It pops when it gets to about one hundred eighty degrees Celsius. The pop is over in about two hundredths of a second. Here, that's about twenty seconds. The shell splits, and the white foam bursts out. That crack you'd hear is the shell giving way. One kernel becomes a fluffy cloud, many times its size. The foam hangs for a moment, then settles in the pan. Over the sink, a soap bubble drifts, about as wide as an egg. Its colors swirl as the wall of the bubble thins. When it pops, the hole races around the film at several meters a second. The whole bubble is gone in about a hundredth of a second. If you just replayed that in your head, tap like and follow. Here, that takes about eleven seconds. And somebody across the kitchen has just clapped. How long does that take to reach you?
lines.phonemes: ɪnðə pˈæn ɔnðə stˈoʊv, ɐ fjˈuː kˈɜːnəlz ʌv pˈɑːpkɔːɹn sˈɪt stˈɪl. ðˈɛn wˈʌn dʒˈʌmps. ɪts hˈɑːɹd ʃˈɛl hˈoʊldz ðə stˈiːm ˈɪn, ʌntˈɪl ðə pɹˈɛʃɚ wˈɪnz. ɪt pˈɑːps wɛn ɪt ɡˈɛts tʊ ɐbˌaʊt wˈʌn hˈʌndɹɪd ˈeɪɾi dᵻɡɹˈiːz sˈɛlsɪəs. ðə pˈɑːp ɪz ˌoʊvɚɹ ɪn ɐbˌaʊt tˈuː hˈʌndɹədθs əvə sˈɛkənd. hˈɪɹ, ðæts ɐbˌaʊt twˈɛnti sˈɛkəndz. ðə ʃˈɛl splˈɪts, ænd ðə wˈaɪt fˈoʊm bˈɜːsts ˈaʊt. ðæt kɹˈæk juːd hˈɪɹ ɪz ðə ʃˈɛl ɡˈɪvɪŋ wˈeɪ. wˈʌn kˈɜːnəl bɪkˌʌmz ɐ flˈʌfi klˈaʊd, mˈɛni tˈaɪmz ɪts sˈaɪz. ðə fˈoʊm hˈæŋz fɚɹə mˈoʊmənt, ðˈɛn sˈɛɾəlz ɪnðə pˈæn. ˌoʊvɚ ðə sˈɪŋk, ɐ sˈoʊp bˈʌbəl dɹˈɪfts, ɐbˌaʊt æz wˈaɪd æz ɐn ˈɛɡ. ɪts kˈʌlɚz swˈɜːl æz ðə wˈɔːl ʌvðə bˈʌbəl θˈɪnz. wˌɛn ɪt pˈɑːps, ðə hˈoʊl ɹˈeɪsᵻz ɚɹˈaʊnd ðə fˈɪlm æt sˈɛvɹəl mˈiːɾɚz ɐ sˈɛkənd. ðə hˈoʊl bˈʌbəl ɪz ɡɔn ɪn ɐbˌaʊt ɐ hˈʌndɹədθ əvə sˈɛkənd. ɪf juː dʒˈʌst ɹˈiːpleɪd ðæt ɪn jʊɹ hˈɛd, tˈæp lˈaɪk ænd fˈɑːloʊ. hˈɪɹ, ðæt tˈeɪks ɐbˌaʊt ᵻlˈɛvən sˈɛkəndz. ænd sˈʌmbɑːdi əkɹˌɑːs ðə kˈɪtʃən hɐz dʒˈʌst klˈæpt. hˌaʊ lˈɔŋ dˈʌz ðæt tˈeɪk tə ɹˈiːtʃ juː?
